summary: Sezzle Inc. filed an August 28, 2026, Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders to be held on November 19, 2026, online via webcast. Because the meeting date is over 30 days from the 2025 meeting anniversary, the company set deadlines for stockholder proposals and director nominations: September 23, 2026, for Rule 14a-8 proposals, and September 7, 2026, for advance notice under bylaws. This is a routine meeting notice setting procedural dates, not a special situation.
